title: KPT: distinguish the families
focus: Distinguish the separately learned KPT families, including the two special k patterns.

exercises.prompt: What KPT change appears in pankki (“bank”) → pankin (“of the bank”)?
exercises.explanation: A double k weakens to one k.

optionFeedback.kk → k: Correct. A double k weakens to one k.
optionFeedback.k → j: “k → j” does not show the required pattern. A double k weakens to one k.
optionFeedback.nk → ng: “nk → ng” does not show the required pattern. A double k weakens to one k.
